hypothesis: H-THD: 3x3 local maxima of the label-free horizontal magnetic gradient (tmi_hg), percentile-thresholded, minus a 3-px collar around mapped faults, is a usable off-catalogue fault candidate set.
mechanism: Horizontal gradient maxima of total magnetic intensity sit over lateral susceptibility contrasts; fault-bounded blocks produce such contrasts.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic/intrusive susceptibility contrasts (magnetite-bearing units, dykes, contacts) and cultural magnetic noise (fences, rail, pipelines) produce the same gradient maxima without faulting.
